result.topic_en: Copy of a fragment evaluating log k (the elliptic modulus) as a series in q = e^{xi} at the rational points x = 2mπ/n and x = mπ/n, reducing the values via integrals and roots of unity to finite sums involving the fractional-part function E.
result.transcription:
[-höchst blasse und verwischte, kaum zu entziffernde Bleistiftschrift auf einer Folioseite-] . 7.
[-Fragment-] . II .
$\log k = \log 4\sqrt{q} + \sum (-1)^n \frac{4}{n} \frac{q^n}{1+q^n}$ , $q = e^{xi}$ . [-der imaginären-]
1) $x = \frac{2m}{n}\pi$ , n ungerade . [-der imaginären Theil von logk-]
$\log k = i\left(\frac{x}{2} + \sum (-1)^s \frac{2}{s} \operatorname{tg} s\frac{x}{2}\right)$
$= i\left(\frac{x}{2} + \sum_{0,\infty}^{t} \sum_{1,2n}^{s} (-1)^s \frac{2}{2nt+s} \operatorname{tg}\frac{sm}{n}\pi\right)$
$= i\frac{x}{2} + 2i\int_0^1 \sum_{1,2n}^{s} (-1)^s \operatorname{tg}\frac{sm}{n}\pi \, \frac{x^{s-1}dx}{1-x^{2n}}$
$= i\frac{x}{2} + 2\int_0^1 \sum_{1,2n}^{s} (-1)^s \frac{\alpha^{2sm}-1}{\alpha^{2sm}+1} \cdot \frac{1}{2n}\sum_{1,2n}^{t} \frac{\alpha^{-ts}\alpha^t dx}{1-\alpha^t x}$ , $\alpha = e^{\frac{2\pi i}{2n}}$
$= i\frac{x}{2} + \frac{1}{2n}\int_0^1 \sum_{1,2n}^{t} \frac{\alpha^t dx}{1-\alpha^t x} \cdot 2\sum_{1,n-1}^{\sigma} \sum_{1,2n}^{s} (-1)^{s+\sigma-1} \alpha^{s(2m\sigma - t)}$
$\frac{1}{1+r\alpha^{2sm}} = \sum \frac{(-1)^\sigma \alpha^{2s\sigma m} r^\sigma}{1-r^{2n}} = -\frac{1}{2n}\sum_{0,2n-1}(-1)^\sigma \sigma \alpha^{2s\sigma m}$
$= \frac{1}{2}\sum_{0,n-1}(-1)^\sigma \alpha^{2s\sigma m}$
$= i\frac{x}{2} + 2\sum_{1,n-1} \log(1-\alpha^{n+2m\sigma})(-1)^\sigma$
$= i\frac{x}{2} + \sum_{1,n-1} \log \alpha^{2m\sigma} (-1)^\sigma$
$= i\frac{x}{2} + 2\pi i\left(\sum_{1,n-1} \frac{2m\sigma}{2n}(-1)^\sigma - \sum_{1,n-1}(-1)^\sigma \mathcal{E}\left(\frac{2m\sigma}{2n} + \frac{1}{2}\right)\right)$
2) $x = \frac{m}{n}\pi$ , m, n ungerade .
$\log k = -\frac{q+q_0}{q-q_0} \cdot \frac{3}{2n^2}\sum_{1,\infty}\frac{1}{s^2} - \frac{1}{n}\log\frac{1+q^n}{1-q^n} + \frac{x}{2}i + 2\int_0^1 \sum_{1,4n-1}^{s} (-1)^s \frac{x^{s-1}dx}{1-x^{4n}} \cdot \frac{\alpha^{2ms}-1}{\alpha^{2ms}+1}$
$= A + \frac{x}{2}i + 2\int_0^1 \sum_{1,4n}^{t} \frac{\alpha^t dx}{1-\alpha^t x} \cdot \frac{1}{4n} \cdot -\frac{1}{2n}\sum_{1,4n-1}^{s} \sum_{0,2n-1}^{\sigma} (-1)^{s+\sigma} \sigma \alpha^{2s\sigma m}(\alpha^{2ms}-1)\alpha^{-st}$
$= A + \frac{x}{2}i + 2 \cdot 2\pi i \sum_{1,n-1} \frac{s}{n}(-1)^s \left(\frac{ms-n}{2n} - \mathcal{E}\frac{ms}{2n}\right)$ , $m\mu \equiv 1$ (mod. 2n)
$= A + \pi i\left(\frac{m-\mu}{2} + \frac{\mu}{2n} + 2\sum_{1,n-1} \mathcal{E}\frac{\mu s}{2n}(-1)^s - 2\sum_{1,n-1} \mathcal{E}\frac{ms}{2n}(-1)^s\right)$

methods.what: q-series expansion of log of the elliptic modulus k
Boundary value of log k on |q|=1 as a tangent series
Converting the periodic series into an integral of a rational function via x^{s-1}/(1-x^{2n})
Partial fraction decomposition with 2n-th roots of unity α
Finite expansion of 1/(1+rα^{2sm}) as a sum over roots of unity
Closed form of log k at x = 2mπ/n via fractional-part (E) sums
Closed form of log k at x = mπ/n (m,n odd) with modular inverse μ of m mod 2n, a reciprocity-type expression
